source.name: Form EIA-860M, Preliminary Monthly Electric Generator Inventory
source.license: Public domain (U.S. government work). EIA asks to be credited as the source, with the release date.

method: Read the "Operating" sheet: every operable generator at plants of 1 MW or more, including standby units and units out of service.
Summed nameplate capacity (MW) across each plant's generators. Capacities are EIA's preliminary estimates for the month.
A plant's fuel is the one with the most nameplate capacity there; its operator and balancing authority are the ones listed for the most capacity.
Kept plants of 250 MW and up, plus every nuclear plant. Puerto Rico is a separate sheet and is not read.
Coordinates are EIA's, rounded to four decimal places. Nothing is estimated or added by GridTilt.
